text: How many total points did LeBron James score in his NBA regular season career to become the all-time scoring leader?
explanation: LeBron James passed Kareem Abdul-Jabbar's record of 38,387 points in 2023.
estimationApproach: Estimate 20 seasons, 70 games a season, 27 points per game. 20 * 70 = 1400. 1400 * 27 = 37,800. Add a few more seasons.
hint: He averages around 27 points per game.

text: What is the official seating capacity of the Narendra Modi Stadium in India?
explanation: Narendra Modi Stadium in Ahmedabad overtook the MCG as the largest cricket stadium.
estimationApproach: The largest stadiums in the world hold around 100k.

text: How many career passing yards did Tom Brady accumulate in the NFL regular season?
explanation: Tom Brady holds the record for the most regular-season passing yards in NFL history.
estimationApproach: 23 seasons. Assume 15 seasons of 4k yards (60k), plus 8 seasons of 3.5k yards (28k).

text: How many Olympic gold medals has Michael Phelps won in his career?
explanation: Michael Phelps is the most decorated Olympian of all time.
estimationApproach: He dominated 4 Olympics, winning 6, 8, 4, and 5 golds respectively.
hint: He won 8 golds in Beijing alone.

text: What was the estimated global TV audience for the 2022 FIFA World Cup final?
explanation: The 2022 World Cup final was one of the most-watched sporting events.
estimationApproach: Global pop is 8B. Maybe 1 in 5 people worldwide watched.

text: How many dimples are on a standard golf ball?
explanation: Most standard golf balls have between 300 and 400 dimples.
estimationApproach: Surface area is 18 cm^2. A dimple is 0.15 cm in diameter. Packing gives 300-400.

text: How many grand slam singles titles has Serena Williams won?
explanation: Serena Williams holds the record for most Grand Slam titles in the Open Era.
estimationApproach: She played for over 20 years, winning 1-2 slams a year on average.
hint: She is one shy of Margaret Court's all-time record.

text: What is the distance of a standard marathon in meters?
explanation: A marathon is exactly 26.2 miles.

text: How many games are played in a full Major League Baseball (MLB) regular season by all 30 teams combined?
explanation: Each of the 30 teams plays 162 games.

text: What is the seating capacity of the Michigan Stadium?
explanation: The University of Michigan's football stadium is the largest stadium in the US.
estimationApproach: The largest college football stadiums are just over 100k.

text: How many goals did Wayne Gretzky score in his NHL career (regular season)?
explanation: Wayne Gretzky is the all-time leading goal scorer in NHL history.
estimationApproach: He played about 20 seasons, averaging over 40 goals a season.
hint: It is just shy of 900 goals.

text: How many total medals did the USA win at the 2020 Tokyo Summer Olympics?
explanation: The USA led the overall medal count at the delayed 2020 Tokyo Olympics.
estimationApproach: The US usually wins between 100 and 120 medals at the Summer Games.

text: What is the total prize money purse for the US Open tennis tournament (in USD)?
explanation: The US Open has the largest prize money purse of all the Grand Slams.
estimationApproach: Winners get about $3M each. Adds up to tens of millions.
hint: It was raised to $65 million recently.

text: How many minutes long is a standard professional soccer match (excluding stoppage time)?
explanation: A standard match consists of two 45-minute halves.
estimationApproach: Two halves of 45 minutes each.

text: What was the average annual salary of an NBA player during the 2023-2024 season (in USD)?
explanation: NBA players have the highest average salary among major sports leagues.
estimationApproach: Salary cap is around $136M. 15 players per team. $136M / 15 = ~$9M average.

text: How many distinct events are there in the decathlon?
explanation: The prefix 'deca-' means ten.
estimationApproach: Deca means 10.

text: How many total times has Rafael Nadal won the French Open men's singles title?
explanation: Rafael Nadal's dominance on clay led him to win Roland Garros a record 14 times.
estimationApproach: He dominated from 2005 to 2022. He won it almost every year.

text: How many Super Bowl rings does the New England Patriots franchise have?
explanation: The Patriots have won 6 Super Bowls, all under Belichick and Brady.
hint: Tied for the most in NFL history.

text: How many points is a touchdown worth in American football (excluding the extra point)?
explanation: A standard touchdown is worth 6 points.
estimationApproach: Common knowledge of NFL rules.

text: What is the weight of a standard Olympic men's shot put in kilograms?
explanation: The men's shot put weighs exactly 16 pounds.

text: How many total matches are played in a standard 32-team FIFA World Cup tournament?
explanation: 8 groups of 4 teams = 48 group stage matches. 16 knockout matches = 64 total.

text: What is the maximum number of clubs a golfer can carry in their bag?
explanation: The USGA and R&A rules state a player is allowed a maximum of 14 clubs.
estimationApproach: Driver, 2 woods, 7 irons, 3 wedges, 1 putter.
hint: Two weeks is this many days.

text: How many home runs did Barry Bonds hit in his record-breaking 2001 MLB season?
explanation: Barry Bonds set the single-season MLB home run record with 73.
estimationApproach: Mark McGwire hit 70. Bonds beat him by a few.

text: What is the diameter of a standard basketball hoop in inches?
explanation: A standard basketball rim is exactly 18 inches in diameter.
estimationApproach: A basketball is about 9.5 inches in diameter. The hoop is about twice that size.

text: How many total rounds are there in the NFL Draft?
explanation: Since 1994, the NFL draft has consisted of 7 rounds.
estimationApproach: There are about 250 picks across 32 teams. 250 / 32 is roughly 7.

text: What is the height of a regulation tennis net at the center in inches?
explanation: A tennis net is 3 feet (36 inches) high at the center.
estimationApproach: It is exactly one yard tall at the center.

text: How many players are on the field for one team in a standard field hockey match?
explanation: Like soccer and cricket, a field hockey team fields 11 players.
estimationApproach: Same number as soccer.

text: What was the highest attendance ever recorded for WrestleMania (WrestleMania 32)?
explanation: WrestleMania 32 at AT&T Stadium claimed an attendance of over 101,000.
estimationApproach: AT&T stadium holds 80k for football, but adds floor seating for wrestling.

text: How many matches did the Undertaker win at WrestleMania before his first loss?
explanation: The Undertaker had a 21-0 undefeated Streak at WrestleMania.
estimationApproach: He debuted in 1990 and lost in 2014.
hint: The age of majority in the US.

text: How many personal fouls does an NBA player need to commit to foul out?
explanation: In the NBA, a player fouls out after their 6th personal foul.
estimationApproach: NBA games are 48 minutes, longer than college, so they get 6 fouls.

text: How many total Grand Prix races were scheduled in the 2024 Formula 1 season?
explanation: The 2024 F1 calendar features a record 24 Grands Prix.
estimationApproach: The calendar has been expanding from around 20.

text: What is the length of a standard Olympic swimming pool in meters?
explanation: Olympic pools are also known as long course pools and are 50 meters long.
estimationApproach: Half of 100.

text: How many balls are used in a standard game of snooker?
explanation: A snooker game uses 1 cue ball, 15 red balls, and 6 colored balls.

text: How many times has Brazil won the FIFA Men's World Cup?
explanation: Brazil is the most successful nation in World Cup history with 5 titles.
estimationApproach: They have 5 stars on their jersey.

text: How many points is a drop goal worth in rugby union?
explanation: In rugby union, a drop goal is worth 3 points.
estimationApproach: Same as a penalty kick in rugby union.
hint: Same as a field goal in American football.

text: What was the highest score ever achieved by a single player in an NBA game?
explanation: Wilt Chamberlain scored 100 points in a game in 1962.
estimationApproach: Famous sports trivia.

text: How many periods are in a standard NHL ice hockey game?
explanation: Ice hockey is played in three 20-minute periods.
estimationApproach: Unlike halves or quarters, it's divided into thirds.
hint: A hat trick is when a player scores this many goals.

text: How many times did Usain Bolt win the 100m Olympic gold medal?
explanation: Usain Bolt won three consecutive 100m golds in 2008, 2012, and 2016.
estimationApproach: He dominated three Olympic cycles.
hint: He also won the 200m the same number of times.

text: What is the weight of a standard ten-pin bowling ball used by male pros in pounds?
explanation: The maximum legal weight for a bowling ball is 16 pounds.
estimationApproach: Usually between 14 and 16 pounds.

text: How many total squares are on a standard chessboard?
explanation: A chessboard is an 8x8 grid.
estimationApproach: 8 multiplied by 8.

text: How many sets are needed to win a men's singles match at a Grand Slam?
explanation: Men's Grand Slam matches are best of five sets.
estimationApproach: Best of 5 means first to 3.

text: What is the world record time for the men's marathon in seconds?
explanation: Kelvin Kiptum ran 2:00:35, which is 7235 seconds.
estimationApproach: 2 hours is 7200 seconds. Add a little bit.

text: How many regular season games does an NFL team play (as of 2021)?
explanation: The NFL expanded the regular season from 16 to 17 games starting in 2021.
estimationApproach: It was 16 for a long time, now it's 17.

text: What is the diameter of a standard Table Tennis ball in millimeters?
explanation: In 2000, the ITTF increased the ball diameter from 38mm to 40mm.
estimationApproach: It's about 4 cm.
hint: It was changed from 38mm to this nice round number.

text: How many total bases are there on a baseball field (including home plate)?
explanation: First, second, third base, and home plate make 4.
estimationApproach: A 'home run' touches all 4.
hint: The number of balls for a walk.

text: What was the transfer fee paid for Neymar to PSG in euros?
explanation: PSG paid Neymar's €222 million release clause.
estimationApproach: It was over 200 million euros.

text: How many times did Muhammad Ali win the World Heavyweight Boxing Championship?
explanation: Ali won the championship three times (1964, 1974, 1978).
estimationApproach: He had distinct eras: Liston, Foreman, and Spinks.
hint: He won it in three different decades.

text: What is the maximum break in a single visit to the table in snooker?
explanation: Potting all 15 reds with 15 blacks (120), then 6 colors (27) equals 147.

text: How many minutes long is a standard quarter in an NFL game?
explanation: An NFL game has four 15-minute quarters.
estimationApproach: 60 minutes divided by 4.

text: What is the height of a regulation NBA basketball hoop in feet?
explanation: The standard height for a basketball hoop is 10 feet.
estimationApproach: Common knowledge.

text: How many points does a player get for a bullseye in standard Darts?
explanation: The inner bullseye is worth 50 points.
estimationApproach: It's a nice round number in darts.

text: How many times did the Chicago Bulls win the NBA Championship in the 1990s?
explanation: The Bulls won two three-peats in 1991-93 and 1996-98.
estimationApproach: Two three-peats.

text: How many players make up a standard volleyball team on the court?
explanation: Indoor volleyball has 6 players on the court per team.
estimationApproach: 3 in the front row, 3 in the back row.

text: What is the total distance of an Ironman Triathlon in miles?
explanation: An Ironman is a 2.4-mile swim, 112-mile bike, and a 26.2-mile run.

text: How many gold medals did the Miracle on Ice US men's hockey team win in 1980?
explanation: They won the gold medal after upsetting the Soviet Union.
estimationApproach: A team only wins one gold medal per tournament.

text: What is the length of a standard cricket pitch in yards?
explanation: A cricket pitch is exactly 22 yards long, which is also one chain.
estimationApproach: It is exactly 1 chain.
hint: The number of players on a soccer field total.

text: How many points is a try worth in modern Rugby Union?
explanation: A try was increased to 5 points in 1992.
estimationApproach: It's the highest scoring play, more than a penalty (3).

text: How many total games are required to win a standard set in tennis (without a tiebreak)?
explanation: A player must win 6 games to win a standard set.
estimationApproach: First to 6 wins the set.

text: What is the par for a typical 18-hole championship golf course?
explanation: Most standard 18-hole courses have a par of 72.
estimationApproach: Average par per hole is 4. 18 * 4 = 72.

text: How many times did the New York Yankees win the World Series in the 20th century?
explanation: The Yankees won 25 of their 27 championships in the 20th century.
estimationApproach: They have 27 total. 2000 and 2009 were in the 21st century.

text: How many starting players are there on a Canadian Football League (CFL) team on the field?
explanation: The CFL uses 12 players per side, unlike the NFL's 11.
estimationApproach: One more than American football.

text: What is the weight of a standard men's Olympic discus in kilograms?
explanation: The men's discus weighs 2.0 kg.
estimationApproach: It's relatively light compared to the shot put, exactly 2 kg.

text: How many minutes does a player sit in the penalty box for a minor penalty in ice hockey?
explanation: A minor penalty in the NHL results in a 2-minute disadvantage.
estimationApproach: Standard powerplay length.

text: How many points is a safety worth in American football?
explanation: Tackling an offensive player in their own end zone results in a safety, worth 2 points.
estimationApproach: It's a rare scoring play worth less than a field goal.

text: What is the distance of the Kentucky Derby horse race in furlongs?
explanation: The Kentucky Derby is 1 and 1/4 miles, which equals 10 furlongs.
estimationApproach: 1.25 miles = 10/8 miles = 10 furlongs.

text: How many total periods of overtime can be played in an NHL regular season game before a shootout?
explanation: In the regular season, there is one 5-minute overtime period.
estimationApproach: They want to end games quickly in the regular season.

text: How many hurdles are cleared by a runner in a standard 110m hurdle race?
explanation: Athletes clear 10 hurdles over the 110m distance.
estimationApproach: It's a nice even number, 10 hurdles.

text: What is the maximum number of players on a standard active NFL roster?
explanation: NFL teams are limited to 53 players on their active roster.
estimationApproach: It's in the low 50s. 53-man roster is famous.

text: How many times did Tiger Woods win the Masters Tournament?
explanation: Tiger Woods won the Masters in 1997, 2001, 2002, 2005, and 2019.
estimationApproach: He is one behind Jack Nicklaus's record of 6.

text: How many pins are set up at the end of a lane in standard ten-pin bowling?
explanation: The name of the sport is ten-pin bowling.
estimationApproach: It's in the name.

text: What is the perfect score in a gymnastics floor routine (pre-2006 scoring system)?
explanation: The Perfect 10 was the hallmark of gymnastics scoring.
estimationApproach: Nadia Comăneci's famous score.

text: How many total matches are played in a standard Premier League season by all teams combined?
explanation: 20 teams play 38 matches each. 20 * 38 / 2 = 380.
estimationApproach: 20 teams, each plays 38 games. (20 * 38)/2 = 380.
hint: Ten times the number of matches each team plays.

text: How many gold medals did Eric Heiden win at the 1980 Winter Olympics?
explanation: Eric Heiden won all 5 individual men's speed skating events.
estimationApproach: He swept the speed skating events.
hint: One for each finger on a hand.

text: How many points is a free throw worth in basketball?
explanation: A free throw is worth 1 point.
estimationApproach: The lowest scoring play in basketball.

text: How many players are on a standard water polo team in the water at one time?
explanation: A water polo team consists of 6 outfield players and 1 goalkeeper.
